title: Batch 2: recover image errors that occur before hydration
summary: Repeated failure injection exposed a timing race: optimized category requests could fail before the React error handler attached. Check completed broken images at hydration and fall back to original artwork.

changes.detail: Hydration effect checks complete/currentSrc/naturalWidth in addition to onError, restoring original source for early image failures.

validation.name: Failure reproduction
validation.detail: Full browser runs reproduced complete images with naturalWidth zero and optimized currentSrc; a focused run passed, identifying a timing-dependent race. Failed evidence retained.
